method: Read the complete report and compare its implementation, test, warning, and scope statements with the saved focused test output, source-stability manifest, current slice diff, and cited review handoff.
score_reason: The report is concrete and scoped, though the required section structure gives it some checklist rhythm.
confidence_reason: The report is short and evidence-linked; its style judgment is editorial and the checklist structure limits confidence.
